hint.text:
Exclamation marks are not used in formal speech and writing.

Informal: I am very excited about the holidays!

Formal: I am very excited about the holidays.
hint.sound: Exclamation marks are not used in formal speech and writing.  For example, informally you could say 'I am very excited about the holidays!' with an exclamation mark, and formally you could say 'I am very excited about the holidays.' without an exclamation mark.

sounds.fileId: sound/en/f3_2025/Bullying is an incredibly horrible act that unfortunately affects many people. It is an appalling situation. It may not always seem that harmful, but it can have huge impacts on the victim’s mental health. It can happen anywhere, including online. It cannot continue to happen. The best thing to do is to tell an adult you can trust, like a teacher or relative, as soon as you notice the bullying. We must all play a part in stopping bullying.

sound/en/f3_2025/Exclamation marks are not used in formal speech and writing.  For example, informally you could say 'I am very excited about the holidays!' with an exclamation mark, and formally you could say 'I am very excited about the holidays.' without an exclamation mark.
sound/en/f3_2025/I am never going to watch a horror film ever again!

sound/en/f3_2025/I am very happy. Today, my family and I are going to visit my grandma in Poland, and I am so excited to see her. It has been 4 years since I last saw her. It is a big day for everyone in my family, and we have been looking forward to it for months. It will be incredible. My grandma told us she is preparing a feast for when we arrive. I cannot wait for the plane to land.
sound/en/f3_2025/It can happen anywhere, even online!
sound/en/f3_2025/My little brother was so frightened!

sound/en/f3_2025/That film scared me so much. My mum took me and my younger brother to the cinema last week. Unfortunately, none of us knew how terrifying it would be. My little brother was incredibly frightened. There were so many jump-scares that made my heart stop. The characters were spine-chilling. I will never watch another horror film.
